== Zobo Horde Invasion ==

The Zobo Horde is an event where you can team up with another player (whether it's a friend you can invite, or you can do a random team-up with another player who's also currently looking.) It will be seasonally updated with new Horde-Only Buffs and Nerfs for specific Tatari every 4 weeks.  

There is 3 rounds that you can play, and the event happens every 4 hours- 3 hours where you have a chance to play your 3 rounds, and 1 hour of cooldown before it starts again. 

Your score for the event is the highest score you have earned out of those 3 rounds. You can play the event several time a day, each time it's active, however you will only earn placement rewards once- or if you place higher than a previous attempt in the day, you will earn the difference in rewards for the new placement. You will not be able to earn more total rewards than the first place payout per day.

Each total round is 25 waves, or 750 kills, in which you face various [[Zobos|Boss Zobos]] at the end of each wave. 

During the Horde Invasion, if your camp happens to be one that's under attack you will be unable to interact with your camp at all until it's over. 

There are 4 difficulties to beat, starting at 1, the easiest, and ending at 4, the hardest. If you beat a difficulty for the first time, it does not use one of your 3/3 attempts. 

Leaderboard rankings are based not only on kills, but also the difficulty those kills were made. So a player with 10 Kills on difficulty 4 will rank higher than a player with 745 kills on difficulty 3. 

Horde also contains a mechanic called Chips, which give randomized buffs throughout the game.

=== Chips ===
Chips are a randomized buff/effect the player can gain during a horde run. You can have a maximum of 3 chips per person (6 total), and the rarity is random, alongside which 3 chips will appear to be chosen from. A boss containing a chip will appear every 5 waves, and is indicated by having a chip symbol above their head, of which the color of the chip indicates its rarity, and after being defeated, a popup will appear with 3 chips to choose from.

===Tatari Skills===
[[Tatari|Tataris]] all have various skills they can use specific to this game mode. They are able to be upgraded 7 times total, with new skills being learned at levels 3, 5, and 7. Each level up earns the tatari a stat increase.

All skills are the same across the entire tatari's evolutionary line -- minus the tatari's base skill. Base skills are the tatari's standard skill they have in both the [[Battle]] and [[Boss Challenge]] modes.

This will make evolved tataris stronger than their base forms, but the skillset they learn via level up in this game mode will be the same.

== Old Horde Invasion (Prior to 8/26/26) ==
The Zobo Horde is an event where you can team up with another player (whether it's a friend you can invite, or you can do a random team-up with another player who's also currently looking.)

There is 3 rounds that you can play, and the event happens every 3 hours- 2 hours where you have a chance to play your 3 rounds, and 1 hour of cooldown before it starts again. 

Your score for the event is the highest score you have earned out of those 3 rounds. You can play the event several time a day, each time it's active, however you will only earn placement rewards once- or if you place higher than a previous attempt in the day, you will earn the difference in rewards for the new placement. You will not be able to earn more total rewards than the first place payout per day.

Each total round is 35 waves, in which you face various [[Zobos|Boss Zobos]] at the end of each wave. 

During the Horde Invasion, if your camp happens to be one that's under attack you will be unable to interact with your camp at all until it's over. 

===Waves and Bosses===
Enemy [[Zobos]] will get progressively stronger as the wave number gets higher.
The number of the final wave is 35, and the wave 20, 25, 30 and 35 feature two bosses each.
